- Tax at Lovable is a small central team covering everything from structuring and transfer pricing to tax accounting and compliance. This role sits on the operational side: the checks and controls that keep a multi-entity business compliant day to day.

- Excellent English (our company language).

- Based in Stockholm or willing to relocate.

- Systematic and automated VAT ID validation on customers and vendors

- Withholding tax on outbound payments, including W-forms

- US sales tax exemption certificates and related forms

- Reviewing customer and supplier invoices and expenses for correct tax treatment and deductibility
